s0.description: Cover: the override gap between system recommendation and managerial decision.

s1.description: Context: data-rich B2B decisions, contested literature, our research question and method.

s2.description: Field evidence: six decision episodes where the system was negotiated, not obeyed.

s3.description: Sensemaking: four decision logics and three cross-cutting patterns.

s4.description: Implications for B2B marketing practice, mapped to each logic.
